name: M7.Factorized.numerator_record_card
statement: ∀ (U S T : Type) [Fintype U] [Fintype S] [Fintype T] (sector : U → Prop) (left : U → S → Prop) (right : U → T → Prop), M7.Factorized.numerator sector left right = (M7.Factorized.records sector left right).card
context:
theorem M7.Factorized.pair_count : ∀ (S T : Type) [Fintype S] [Fintype T] (left : S → Prop) (right : T → Prop), M7.Factorized.count (fun p : S × T => left p.1 ∧ right p.2) = M7.Factorized.count left * M7.Factorized.count right := by
  intro S T instS instT left right
  classical
  unfold M7.Factorized.count
  rw [← Finset.card_product]
  apply congrArg Finset.card
  apply Finset.ext
  intro p
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
guidance: Split finite triple cardinality into sum over U and filtered pair cardinality. Equivalently rewrite card as sum of indicators, Fintype.sum_prod_type, and distribute separate sums. Sector indicator is counted once. No group action assumed. Return tactic lines only without leading by.
